scenarios.scenario_abstract: While furnishing one living room around an existing focal piece, [X] coordinates owned pillows, a throw, curtains, wood, trays, and decor before choosing a rug and coffee table. The conversation revisits the palette after each large surface is introduced so the room stays coherent without becoming visually heavy.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 围绕既有视觉主体布置同一间客厅时，[X]会先协调已有的靠垫、盖毯、窗帘、木质家具、托盘和摆件，再选择地毯与茶几；每加入一个大面积表面，后续回合都会重新检查整体配色，避免空间杂乱或显得沉重。
scenarios.multi_turn_confirmation: After one large surface or focal object is selected, a later turn introduces the next owned or proposed element and checks whether the palette still feels coherent and sufficiently light.

scenarios.scenario_abstract: While creating an at-home birthday invitation, [X] keeps a floral border they already like but distinguishes the full background from the flowers and text when requesting a color change. A later revision must be checked against that layer-specific instruction rather than treating any recolored element as completion.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 制作居家生日会邀请函时，[X]保留已经喜欢的花卉边框，但在要求改色时明确区分整片背景、花朵和文字；后续回合必须按这一图层要求检查修改，不能把任意元素变色都视为完成。
scenarios.multi_turn_confirmation: A first revision changes one visual layer; a later turn inspects the whole invitation and either confirms the full-field background or corrects a mistaken recoloring of flowers, border, or text.

scenarios.scenario_abstract: While maintaining a fixed visual identity for a fictional character, [X] checks whether a new condition-specific accent remains distinct from the base skin and freckle tones, then retests a small swatch under warm indoor light and daylight. A later turn confirms or corrects the accent after the lighting comparison.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在维持虚构角色既定视觉身份时，[X]先检查新的状态点缀色能否与基础肤色和雀斑色清楚区分，再把小色样放到暖色室内灯和日光下复测；后续回合根据光照对比确认或修正该点缀色。
scenarios.multi_turn_confirmation: A candidate accent is first evaluated against the fixed palette; a later turn compares the same swatch under warm indoor light and daylight and confirms or corrects it if it loses separation.

scenarios.scenario_abstract: While developing a vivid personal painting and then a VR scene, [X] tempers strong hues with cool support, split complements, restrained metallic accents, and gradients, then checks whether the same balance still guides emotion in an immersive space. A later turn revisits the palette after it is seen in the second medium.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在创作一幅鲜艳的个人画作并把同类视觉语言带入 VR 场景时，[X]用冷色支撑、分裂互补、克制的金属点缀和渐变来缓和强烈色彩，再检查这种平衡能否继续引导沉浸空间中的情绪；后续回合会在第二种媒介中实看后重新判断配色。
scenarios.multi_turn_confirmation: The palette is first balanced in a physical or flat artwork; a later turn views it in the immersive medium and checks whether the intended emotional hierarchy survives the increase in apparent intensity.

scenarios.scenario_abstract: While filling twenty-two tiny cubbies in a thrifted Southern Gothic display, [X] narrows listings by size, patina, and religious or oddity character, then compares dark and pale finds across neighboring compartments so the collection reads as one atmosphere rather than identical pieces. A later turn confirms the color rhythm after several real listings are placed together.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在为一个二手淘来的南方哥特式陈列架填充二十二个小格子时，[X]按尺寸、旧包浆以及宗教或奇物气质缩小候选范围，再比较相邻格子中深浅物件的关系，让收藏呈现统一氛围而非堆满同款；后续回合会在若干真实候选并置后确认整体色彩节奏。
scenarios.multi_turn_confirmation: Several real finds are shortlisted and placed in neighboring cubbies over successive turns; a later turn checks the combined dark-light rhythm and removes a piece that breaks the intended atmosphere.

scenarios.scenario_abstract: While turning an ice-cream vector into a freestanding checkout-counter character sign, [X] first explores a clean fresh direction, then changes the palette to a richer retro dessert-shop mood while preserving the same readable silhouette. A later turn confirms the revised palette on the physical counter mock-up.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 把雪糕矢量图改成可立在收银台旁的角色展牌时，[X]先探索干净清新的方向，随后在保持轮廓清晰可读的前提下，把配色改为更浓郁的复古甜品店氛围；后续回合会在实体柜台效果图上确认修改后的方案。
scenarios.multi_turn_confirmation: An initial palette is shown on the character silhouette; a later turn changes the direction and confirms the revised colors on a freestanding counter mock-up rather than accepting the first draft by inertia.

scenarios.scenario_abstract: While producing a roster of 32-by-32 game characters with a normalized palette, [X] reuses a restricted color set across modular parts and hand-drawn frames, testing each new sprite at in-game scale rather than polishing isolated colors. A later turn confirms whether the new character still belongs to the roster after it is placed in Unity.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在用统一色板制作一组 32×32 游戏角色时，[X]让模块化部件和手绘动画帧复用一套受限颜色，并在游戏实际尺寸下测试每个新角色，而不是孤立地打磨单个颜色；后续回合会把角色放进 Unity，与已有角色并排确认其是否仍属于同一套视觉系统。
scenarios.multi_turn_confirmation: A new sprite is first colored with the restricted set; a later turn places it beside existing characters and in a Unity frame to confirm that it belongs to the roster without losing readability.

scenarios.scenario_abstract: While building a reusable grocery spreadsheet with checkboxes, weekly totals, and phone access, [X] uses a restrained visual hierarchy to separate headers, alternating rows, and purchased states without tiring the eye. A later turn checks the same colors on an iPhone and adjusts any state that loses contrast or meaning.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在制作带复选框、每周合计和手机访问能力的可复用购物表时，[X]用克制的视觉层级区分表头、交替行和已购状态，避免久看疲劳；后续回合会在 iPhone 上检查同一套颜色，并调整任何对比度或含义丢失的状态。
scenarios.multi_turn_confirmation: A desktop version first assigns colors to headers, alternating rows, and purchased states; a later turn opens the same sheet on an iPhone and adjusts any state whose contrast or meaning is lost.

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For a major hair change, [X] plans a two-color root-to-end gradient on shoulder-length straight hair and accepts a maintenance schedule to preserve its intended intensity. A later turn after a reference preview, salon result, or first wash confirms the transition direction and saturation.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 为了大幅改变发色，[X]在齐肩直发上规划从发根到发尾的双色渐变，并接受相应的维护安排来保持预期强度；后续回合会在参考预览、到店成品或首次洗发后确认渐变方向与饱和度。
scenarios.multi_turn_confirmation: The gradient direction and intensity are first selected from a reference; a later turn after a preview, salon result, or first wash checks whether the transition and saturation still match that choice.

scenarios.scenario_abstract: While making small winter scented candles as gifts, [X] coordinates a soft wax color, visible botanical elements, simple paper boxes, ribbons, and a minimal label so each layer feels related without becoming identical. A later turn checks the assembled gift under ordinary room light before confirming the palette.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在制作小型冬季香薰蜡烛作为礼物时，[X]协调柔和的蜡体颜色、可见植物元素、简洁纸盒、丝带和极简标签，让各层彼此呼应但不完全同色；后续回合会在普通室内光下查看组装后的礼物，再确认整套配色。
scenarios.multi_turn_confirmation: The wax and botanical appearance is first selected; a later turn assembles the candle, box, ribbon, and label under ordinary room light and confirms that the layers coordinate without becoming indistinguishable.
